summary: setUTCMonth mutates the Date: replace UTC month; optional date defaults from current UTC time; it returns the resulting millisecond time value.

target.notes: Reuse canonical ToNumber helpers/runtime as required by argument static types; preserve mutation only after the specified conversions/calculations.

semantics.coercion: ToNumber supplied arguments in specification order
semantics.description: replace UTC month; optional date defaults from current UTC time

caveats: Explicit undefined is a supplied argument and ToNumber(undefined) is NaN; omitted optional arguments instead use current component defaults.
